data.narrative:
Fourth Power is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Asegun Henry and Arvin Ganesan that has raised $40M+ to date. The frontier-tech energy sector peer universe includes one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private companies operating in similar domains, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Stage-progression analysis provides the primary valuation anchor. Using the $40M total raised as a proxy for post-money valuation and applying a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier between Series A and subsequent financing rounds yields an implied valuation of $80M. Peer-median triangulation is not applicable here; while eight same-sector private companies exist, none meet the thresholds for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier classification needed to establish a reliable median. A broader sectoral median would introduce material noise given Fourth Power's specific technical focus.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $68M to $92M, with $80M as the median point. This range reflects the single quantitative method applied and carries material uncertainty around (1) capital requirements and burn trajectory through the next funding event, (2) technical validation and commercialization risk typical of frontier energy, and (3) the sparse comparable set in this stage and sector. Investors should weight this range as preliminary pending deeper diligence into product-market fit and unit economics.
